title: TSE Resolution No. 23.755/2026 on AI and synthetic content in electoral propaganda for the 2026 elections
title_original: Resolução TSE nº 23.755, de 2 de março de 2026 (altera a Resolução nº 23.610/2019)
summary: Resolution approved unanimously by the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) on 2 March 2026, rapporteur Minister Nunes Marques, as part of the rules package for the October 2026 general elections. It amends Resolution 23.610/2019 to tighten AI rules: format-specific labelling of AI content, a ban on deepfakes that harm or favour candidacies and on sexual manipulations of candidates, a ban on new synthetic content from 72 hours before to 24 hours after the vote, limits on chatbots, a bar on systems recommending candidates, and joint liability for platforms that fail to remove unlabelled content.
key_obligations: Label AI-made content clearly, in a format suited to audio, image, video or print
No new synthetic candidate content from 72 hours before to 24 hours after voting
Chatbots may not impersonate candidates or real people
Platforms jointly liable if they fail to remove unlabelled synthetic content
Fines of R$5,000 to R$30,000 per violation

sources.title: Eleições 2026: uso de inteligência artificial é regulamentado pelo TSE
